limitations: Contact-sheet inspection is not individual-image inspection.
Separate parent files generally captured only; same composition reviewed within enclosing pages.
Original short screenshots predate flow repair and are superseded by final-short-fallback phase.
Full-page browser captures can show fixed navigation midway in a tall document; final-extra viewport captures establish actual mobile bottom context.

No physical device, native screen reader, another browser engine, real API or database proof.
